text:
Unfortunately, this park was a very disappointing experience. It was extremely crowded, with large groups cooking and grilling food everywhere, which made the atmosphere noisy and uncomfortable. EDIT: The entrance near the parking has reopened though the park itself is only open in parts(the restaurant near the main entrance and the former ‘fresh market’ is closed, as is the east side of the park where a lot of construction is ongoing). name: Important Advice
text:
Safa Park was one of the most beautiful parks in Dubai, renowned for its stunning natural beauty and serene atmosphere. The park was located in the heart of the city and was a popular destination for locals and tourists alike.

One of the most striking features of Safa Park was its lush greenery, with trees and flowers adorning the landscape. The park was also home to a picturesque waterfall, which added to its charm and tranquility.

However, since the creation of the Dubai Water Canal, Safa Park has been cut in two, which has significantly impacted its beauty and appeal. What was once a sprawling oasis of greenery is now a shadow of its former self.

Despite the changes, Safa Park still retains some of its original beauty and remains a popular destination for those looking to escape the hustle and bustle of the city. Visitors can still enjoy a peaceful stroll through the park's remaining green spaces, although the loss of the waterfall and some of the park's other features is undoubtedly felt.

name: SGupta G
text:
An important spot in the history of Dubai and the people over there, Safa Park has been going through many redevelopments these years. It is a 64-hectare huge park which was an erstwhile accommodation center for illegal migrants from South Asia mostly. The park came into establishment during 1975 after the inhabitants were removed from there.

Despite its location near to Sheikh Zayed Road, the park creates beautiful anthologies to entertain the people come here to escape from the daily humdrum. All the major sparkles of Dubai are visible from the park as its point of standing is at the center of everything.

Highlights: Among the multiple highlights the park has, the major one is the three lakes within the park that attract an excess of unique species of birds and the park is a haven for 16924 trees belong to different types as well as various bushes. To relax completely, one can find green carpets of grass throughout the park which is kept tidy always, a small forest and a hill that offers a beautiful view of the whole park.

Some come to simply sit and stroll around while some others find the private space to read books. The amusement park within the park has several bikes which attract teenagers as well as it acts as the jogger’s companion.

Location: Sheikh Zayed Road, Dubai, UAE. It is located 10.53 kms southwest of the traditional center of Dubai

Timings: It is open all days from 08:00 am to 10:00 pm. But from Thursday, Friday and Saturday, it will be open from 08:00 to 11:00 pm.

text:
واحده من اقدم حدائق دبي حيث تم افتتاحها في عام1975 وتم تطويرها عدة مرات وكان اهمها سنة 1989  وعام 1992 حيث قام سمو الشيخ محمد بن راشد بإفتتاحها رسمياً وكانت تعتبر اجمل حديقة آنذاك قبل افتتاح الحدائق الاخرى ..
وعند انشاء قناة دبي المائية تم اقتطاع جزء كبير منها وتبقى منها الجزء القليل حالياً ومتوقع تطويرها للتماشى مع تطور المنطقة المحيطة بها
textTranslated: One of Dubai's oldest parks, it opened in 1975 and has been developed several times, the most notable of which was in 1989 and 1992, when His Highness Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid officially opened it. It was considered the most beautiful park at the time, before the other parks were opened. When the Dubai Water Canal was built, a large portion of it was cut off, and only a small portion remains. It is expected to be developed to keep pace with the development of the surrounding area.
